## Description

Provide a clear and concise summary of the changes proposed in this pull request.

## Type of Change

- [ ] `fix`: Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] `feat`: New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] `refactor`: Code restructuring without behavioral change
- [ ] `perf`: Performance improvement
- [ ] `docs`: Documentation updates
- [ ] `chore`: Tooling or build configuration update

## Verification and Testing

Describe the steps you took to verify your changes:

- [ ] Frontend build passes with zero errors (`bun run build`)
- [ ] Tested on Windows desktop surface
- [ ] Verified overlay transparency and non-activating window behavior
- [ ] Verified global hotkeys (`F8`, `F9`, `F7`, `F10`)
- [ ] Tested Discord Rich Presence behavior (if applicable)
